name: Mystery Rummy Jack The Ripper
summary: A rummy-style card game where players meld evidence to identify Jack the Ripper or play a card to help him escape.
rules_text: Players use a custom deck of colored Evidence cards (suspects) and Gavel cards (Victim, Alibi, Suspect, Scene, Commissioner Resigns, Ripper Strikes). 2 players get 10 cards, 3 get 9, 4 get 8. Remaining deck is Case File, top card starts Scotland Yard discard pile which is closed. Turn order is clockwise: optional Vote, mandatory Draw, optional Play, mandatory Discard. Vote may be called once per hand by a player with a meld, before drawing; all players then secretly write a suspect as predicted Ripper. Draw one from Case File or top of Scotland Yard. Play: only one Gavel card per turn (point cards to your area, 0-point to discard). No Evidence can be played until a Victim is in play. Evidence is played as melds of 3+ same color, or as layoffs onto existing melds. Discard one card. Hand ends when a player discards last card, or Ripper Escapes is played (ends immediately), or Case File empties, or Commissioner Resigns forces a discard. Scoring: if Ripper Escapes, holder scores big and others lose points. Otherwise total points per suspect in play; highest total is Ripper (ignoring anyone with Alibi, tie broken by printed order), his Evidence and Suspect points double. Add Gavel points, add 10 for correct vote, subtract unplayable cards left in hand (Victims/Scenes always count negative). First to 100+ after a hand wins.
